description.value: IDDSI food-axis texture levels 4–7 (SNOMED CT-embedded IDDSI concepts), for NutritionOrder.oralDiet.texture.modifier. The IDDSI food axis spans Levels 3–7; Level 3 (Liquidised) is the shared Moderately Thick concept and is not enumerated here, so it is reached through the extensible binding.
